effect.name: GM Text Case Wave
effect.desc: A travelling wave of typography. A sine wave is laid along the line and wherever its crest passes, the characters change - they can invert their current case, force caps, force lower case, alternate one by one, randomise, double themselves, or dissolve into blank space. The wave is a function of the character's position along the line AND of time, so it genuinely travels. Direction picks the spatial coordinate: Forward and Backward run the crest end to end, Center Out starts at the middle and sweeps both ways, Edges In does the reverse, and Random hashes each character so the change boils instead of sweeping. Band Width sets how many characters are caught at once and Band Sharpness decides whether the band has soft shoulders or hard ones.
